senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. זחה)to shine; v. זָהוֹר, זְהוֹרִית.
to look out, beware, be strict (corresp. to b. h. שָׁמַר); v. זָהִיר.

units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. XC, 16</cite> <he>וזִהֲּרוֹ</he> and brightened his countenance.

senses.gloss: (= b. h. הִשָּׁמֵר) to be careful, be strict; to beware, take heed.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 8b:6">Ber. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>הִזָּהֲרוּ בורידין</he> be careful to cut the jugular veins, v. <cite ref="F00093"><he>וָרִיד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 8b">Ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ בזקן וכ׳</he> beware of disregarding an old man who &c.
<cite ref="Nedarim 81a:2">Ned. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ בבני עניים וכ׳</he> take heed of (do not disregard) the children of the poor; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to caution, forewarn, esp. to prohibit by a special law, v. אַזְהָרָה.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 22b">Yeb. 22ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין מַזְהִירִין מן הדין</he> a law derived from analogy (v. <cite ref="D00634"><he>דִּין</he></cite>) is not considered a specified law on which punishment can be executed after due warning.
<cite ref="Zevachim 106b">Zeb. 106ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>לא ענש אא״כ ה׳</he> the Bible text did not pronounce punishment without having expressed a warning (‘thou shalt not’ &c.); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be forewarned, to be forbidden from doing (by a special law).
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 84b:9">Yeb. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>לא הוּזְהֲרוּ וכ׳</he> there is no specific law prohibiting women of legitimate birth to marry men of illegitimate birth.—Part. <he>מוּזְהָר</he>, f. <he>מוּזְהֶרֶת</he>.

<cite ref="Yevamot 84b:15">Ib.</cite> <he>מלמד שהאשה מ׳</he> (the repeated expression, ‘they shall not take’, <cite ref="Leviticus 21:7">Lev. XXI, 7</cite>) intimates that woman is included with man in the prohibition; <cite ref="Leviticus 21:7">ib.</cite> <he>כל היכא דהוא מ׳ היא מ׳</he> wherever the man is cautioned not to marry, the woman (in the same social relation) is cautioned; a. fr. [<cite ref="Leviticus 21:7">Ib.</cite> <he>היא לא מזדהרא</he>, read: <he>מוזהרת</he>.]
